description.short: Dynamically discovered tools for governed squad planning and delivery
description.full: Connects Copilot Cowork to the HVE Squad MCP server. Cowork discovers the server's current tools at runtime, including enabled research, architecture, planning, review, business, backlog, federation, memory, history, run-status, and rendering capabilities. The squad runs server-side under its own gates and returns finished artifacts (squad-guided / embedded).

agentConnectors.description: Governed squad stages served by the hve-squad MCP server (squad-guided / embedded).
